mapper.select: SELECT i.inquiry_id, i.branch_code, i.title, i.content, i.category, i.urgency, i.status, DATE_FORMAT(i.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS created_at_formatted, b.name AS branch_name, r.reply_id, r.author_id, a.emp_no, e.name AS author_name, rb.name AS reply_author_affiliation, r.content AS reply_content, DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS reply_created_at_formatted FROM inquiry i JOIN branch b ON i.branch_code = b.branch_code LEFT JOIN inquiry_reply r ON i.inquiry_id = r.inquiry_id LEFT JOIN account a ON r.author_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN employee e ON a.emp_no = e.emp_no LEFT JOIN branch rb ON a.branch_code = rb.branch_code WHERE i.inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} ORDER BY r.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiry (branch_code, title, content, category, urgency, status) VALUES (#{branchCode}, #{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{urgency}, '대기 중')
INSERT INTO inquiry_reply (inquiry_id, author_id, content) VALUES (#{inquiryId}, #{authorId}, #{content})
mapper.update: UPDATE inquiry SET status = #{status} WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}
